statement: NVIDIA's newsroom for the two weeks to August 20, 2026 shows no earnings-date, Rubin-pricing or Blackwell-pricing release, but does announce an exclusive deal for SB Energy's Ohio campus to host only NVIDIA AI compute.
why: An exclusivity guarantee over a large power-and-datacenter campus locks future capacity to NVIDIA silicon rather than rival accelerators.

impact.mechanism: Committing a named campus to exclusively host NVIDIA compute reserves incoming datacenter capacity for merchant GPUs and forecloses competing silicon at that site.

evidence.excerpt: 'NVIDIA Guarantees SB Energy's PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Ohio to Exclusively Host NVIDIA AI Compute' (press release announcing a partnership for AI compute capacity in Ohio)
No Q2 FY2027 earnings-date announcement, no Rubin-specific pricing release, and no Blackwell pricing release appeared in the newsroom listing for this window as of the fetch.

confidence.basis: Primary source: NVIDIA's own official newsroom index, including a first-party press release title.
